title: New-Age Tech Stocks Miss Market Rally This Week, Paytm Sheds 10.8%
summary: New-age tech stocks largely missed the rally in Indian equities this week, with only 22 of the 69 stocks under…
llm_summary: New‑age tech stocks lagged behind the broader Indian market rally, with only 22 of the 69 listed firms posting gains this week. Paytm led the decline, tumbling 10.8% after a mix of earnings disappointments and regulatory concerns, while many other startups struggled to keep pace with the overall equity surge. The broader trend highlights lingering investor caution toward high‑growth tech names despite a generally bullish market backdrop.
